Industrial Sector Sub-Page

Mining & Heavy Infrastructure

Structural weld testing & heavy machinery fatigue inspection for African mine sites.

Industrial Sector Overview

Mining equipment such as draglines, excavators, crushers, and conveyor structures operate under extreme cyclic loads. IXAR Africa performs routine non-destructive testing to detect fatigue cracks before structural failure occurs.

Primary Field Applications

Excavator boom, arm, and chassis structural weld magnetic particle / ultrasonic NDT
Crusher shaft & mill trunnion ultrasonic fatigue crack evaluation
Mine shaft gantry & conveyor structural steel integrity audits
Thick plate weld Radiographic & Ultrasonic testing according to AWS D1.1
